sources.citation: de Rendinger, Général. 1949. Contribution à l'étude des langues nègres du Centre-africain. Journal de la Société des Africanistes 19(2): 143-194. DOI 10.3406/jafr.1949.2599.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Field notes 1909-12. 'LANGUE MOGUM' pp. 176-179 ('Interlocuteurs particulièrement médiocres') covers pronouns, possessives, demonstratives, noun, adjective, verb, negation, numerals; no phonetics and no remark on accent for Mogum. The only 'accent tonique' remarks (pp. 145, 147-148) are the transcription key (diacritics for vowel quality/length) and the Barma section.

No phonology section; gives classification (East Chadic B.1.1 Dangla group), ~7,000 speakers (1997), and the same four references (Dakouli et al. 1996 Saba survey, Jungraithmayr 1961 and 1964, Rendinger 1949).

sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Bibliography only. Its complete Jegu/Mogum keyword set is four items: de Rendinger 1949 (JSA 19(2):143-94), Jungraithmayr 1961 (Afrika und Übersee 45:95-123), Jungraithmayr 1963/64 (WZKM 59/60:44-51), Kuipers 2019 (Topics in Chadic Linguistics X:143-56). No phonology/tone monograph on Mogum exists in it.
